query:
SELECT (
                   EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM $3::date)::smallint = ANY (weekdays)
                   AND (
                       low_energy
                       OR NOT EXISTS (
                           SELECT 1 FROM low_energy_days l WHERE l.user_id = $1 AND l.date = $3
                       )
                   )
               ) AS "is_scheduled!",
               $3::date > user_today($1, $4) AS "is_future!"
        FROM habits
        WHERE id = $2 AND user_id = $1
